title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Retail credit risk manager em toledo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.    We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.    By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

description:

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em atibaia. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations. Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager      Company Overview:    b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models:  B2 C (exclusive membership services),  B2 B (corporate travel management), and  B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2 B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our  b Td Corp Tool .    This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.      CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)    We are looking for two (2)  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.      Main Responsibilities   • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.   • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email.   • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.   • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.   • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.      Requirements   • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.   • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level   (An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)   • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.   • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.   • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.   Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus      Why Join Us   • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.   • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.   • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.   • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements      b Td Travel Culture:    At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.    b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.      Terms of Employment: Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.    Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team.    Important Note Before Applying:    Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  Linked In profile or  updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a  self-starter ready to deliver results from  day one .    Forget gaming Linked In algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.    Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!      b Td Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.          Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Position Details    Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager    Department: Sales — Latin America    Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM    Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region    Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory      Role Objective    Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.      Primary Responsibilities    Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.  Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.  Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.  Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.  CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.    Qualifications & Experience    What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.  Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).  What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.    About Quectel    Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.    Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In. Atuar no acompanhamento das iniciativas de Clima, Cultura e Engajamento, apoiando a execução de pesquisas, análise de resultados e acompanhamento dos planos de ação; Transformar resultados de pesquisas e outros dados de pessoas em insights e recomendações para apoiar a evolução do clima, da cultura e do engajamento; Desenvolver e acompanhar campanhas de engajamento, comunicação interna e iniciativas relacionadas à Cultura; Acompanhar rituais de reconhecimento e iniciativas de reforço dos valores e comportamentos esperados pela organização; Apoiar a jornada do colaborador, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva e consistente nos diferentes momentos do ciclo; Apoiar projetos de Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional, contribuindo para iniciativas de desenvolvimento, engajamento e experiência do colaborador; Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de DHO, utilizando dados para avaliar a efetividade das iniciativas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria; Conduzir entregas e projetos de média complexidade com autonomia, alinhando prioridades, prazos, escopo e stakeholders; Antecipar riscos e impedimentos, propondo alternativas e soluções para garantir a qualidade e o cumprimento das entregas; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, ferramentas e práticas de DHO; Apoiar a atualização de organogramas e estruturas organizacionais; Atuar de forma integrada com as demais frentes de People, contribuindo para projetos e iniciativas conforme as necessidades e prioridades do negócio.    Requisitos Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência profissional em Recursos Humanos, com atuação em DHO, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento ou áreas relacionadas; Experiência na estruturação e condução de iniciativas de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de necessidades até o acompanhamento dos resultados; Vivência com iniciativas de Clima, Cultura, Engajamento e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas; Experiência no acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de pessoas, com capacidade de identificar tendências, oportunidades e propor ações a partir dos dados; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade para conduzir interações e construir relacionamento com diferentes públicos; Organização, autonomia e capacidade de priorização, com habilidade para conduzir múltiplas demandas e projetos simultaneamente; Perfil colaborativo e facilidade para atuar em parceria com lideranças, BPs e diferentes áreas da organização; Conhecimento em ferramentas Google e experiência com ferramentas corporativas, como Canva, Jira e Slack.    Diferenciais: Pós-graduação em Educação Corporativa, Gestão de Pessoas, Desenvolvimento Organizacional ou áreas correlatas; Experiência com processos de avaliação de desempenho, feedback e construção de PDIs; Conhecimento em People Analytics e utilização de dados para apoiar decisões de desenvolvimento de pessoas; Experiência com ferramentas e sistemas de DHO, como plataformas de treinamento, clima, avaliação de desempenho e desenvolvimento de pessoas (ex.: Qulture. Rocks, Feedz, Sólides, Pulses, entre outras); Conhecimento em metodologias de educação corporativa, como 6 Ds e Kirkpatrick; Conhecimento em metodologias de definição e acompanhamento de objetivos, como OKRs; Formação ou certificação em ferramentas de análise de perfis comportamentais, como DISC, PDA ou MBTI; Experiência com ferramentas de assessment e desenvolvimento de lideranças.    O que você pode esperar dos Supers? Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência; Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo; Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.    O que oferecemos: Modelo de contratação: PJ; Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil; ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais; ♀️Gym Pass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados; Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade; Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar; Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus; Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência; Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais; Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.      E aí, vamos juntos nesse Super Foguete?

Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In. CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Crypto operations specialist em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us    Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.    About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.    What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.  What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.  Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.  What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em rio do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Remote investment lawyer - brazil em quatro barras. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em bragança paulista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em arujá. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Crypto operations specialist em votorantim. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About us    Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.    About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.    What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.  What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.  Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.  What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Director of ecommerce
description:
Confira a vaga para Director of ecommerce em camboriú. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company: Lime Vizio Inc.    Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)    Location: Remote (outside the US)    Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours    Reports to: CEO & Founders      About Lime Vizio    Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.    We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.    We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.    About the Role    You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.    This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.    Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.    What You'll Own E-commerce growth strategy Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Customer journey & UX Merchandising & pricing Checkout optimization A/B testing & experimentation Retention (Email & SMS) SEO commercial performance AI-powered shopping experiences Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations  Key Responsibilities Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor. Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap. Lead CRO and experimentation programs. Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile. Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells. Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing. Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth. Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value. Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.    Success Metrics    You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:   Gross Profit Profit per Visitor Conversion Rate Average Order Value Checkout Completion Repeat Purchase Rate Customer Lifetime Value Incremental Profit from Experiments  Requirements 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce. 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role. Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required). Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability. Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization. Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance. Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams. Excellent English (B2+). Available during Los Angeles business hours. Based outside the United States.  Nice to Have Multi-brand e-commerce Marketplace businesses High-volume online retail Woo Commerce or Shopify AI-powered personalization Behavioral psychology Seasonal or event-driven commerce  This Role Is Not for Someone Who Only manages website content. Focuses on traffic instead of profit. Relies entirely on agencies. Treats CRO as visual redesign. Reports problems without owning implementation. Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.  What We Offer Remote, long-term leadership role. Direct partnership with the CEO and founders. Ownership of commercial growth strategy. Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy. Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

O produto já existe e foi desenvolvido por mim com uso de IA somada minha expertise de +15 anos atuando como Gerente de Projetos em empresas de tecnologia, do zero, incluindo arquitetura, desenvolvimento e integrações.
