title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em jacareí. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em bento gonçalves. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.    Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.    Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.    Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Ai tech lead
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai tech lead em navegantes. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Preferred Time Zone: CT      Must-Have Skills:    Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality AI agents, skills, assistants, workflows, or integrations. Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows; skills, tools, and function calling; Model Context Protocol; prompt and context design; retrieval-augmented generation; enterprise search and data connectors; grounding, citations, memory, and context management; model and agent evaluation; and AI safety and access controls. Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise Saa S, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms. Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, Chat GPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management. Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority.      Nice-to-Have Skills:    Experience with single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, service accounts, delegated authorization, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, Type Script, Java Script, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.      Notes: No direct reports. This role is more leading through influence by setting standards, mentoring other admins/engineers, etc.      Strong preference in AI technology depth, with lighter platform administration experience rather than the other way around.    Scope of Work: The AI Platform Technical Lead is the hands-on technical owner of the organization's general-purpose, AI-enabled collaboration ecosystem, spanning Slack, Google Workspace with Gemini, Glean, and general-purpose AI assistants such as Claude and Chat GPT. Working within the strategy and priorities established by the organization, this role translates platform direction into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The Technical Lead configures, maintains, and improves these platforms based on data and feedback; builds agents and reusable skills; implements integrations; establishes technical patterns; and guides other contributors through technical expertise and example.    Key Responsibilities:   · Design, build, test, and maintain AI agents, skills, prompts, tools, workflows, and automations.   · Build AI solutions using MCP, function calling, APIs, agents, and integration frameworks.   · Translate business needs into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready AI capabilities.   · Build secure integrations across Slack, Google Workspace/Gemini, Glean, AI assistants, and enterprise systems.   · Develop APIs, data connectors, webhooks, search integrations, and RAG/semantic-search solutions.   · Ensure AI systems preserve source-system permissions, access controls, data security, and governance requirements.   · Test and evaluate AI solutions for quality, reliability, safety, performance, and data grounding.   · Administer and optimize enterprise AI platforms, including access, configurations, integrations, monitoring, and lifecycle management.   · Troubleshoot complex AI platform, integration, connector, and data-retrieval issues.   · Establish standards for AI agents, integrations, configurations, testing, deployment, and security.   · Lead technical solution reviews, mentor contributors, and serve as the senior technical escalation point.   · Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide technical recommendations to platform leadership.

About the Company      Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.      Company Website:      About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors      Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.      We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.      Key Responsibilities     Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network. Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships. Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement. Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate. Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.    Preferred Qualifications Passion for football and the business of sports. Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader. Strong professional network that can support club growth. Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.    Compensation & Benefits      This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.      Why Join Us      Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.      Equal Opportunity Statement      Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.      Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em sumaré. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.    Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.    Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.    Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
Nova oportunidade para Director of strategic partnerships em flores da cunha. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT ELIFE    Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.      THE ROLE    We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.    This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.      WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships    WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia    WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM    MARKET CONTEXT    Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!    Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.      What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?    You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.    If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.    When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!      In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:     Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:     Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:    Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Regulatory compliance manager (crypto)
description:
Confira a vaga para Regulatory compliance manager (crypto) em itu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Remote: Brazil - Remote    Full time      About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.    We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme Supporting regulatory licence applications Monitoring, testing, and reporting on the effectiveness of our regulatory architecture Drafting, implementing, and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks, and policies Providing expert regulatory advice to the Operations teams to support product launches Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme    What you'll need 4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.    We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Planejador financeiro / consultor de investimentos (pessoa física)
description:
Confira a vaga para Planejador financeiro / consultor de investimentos (pessoa física) em gaspar. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital.  Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.    Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.    Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!      Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:      O Grupo Capital:      Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.      Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.      Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.      Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.      Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:      A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.      Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.      Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.      Responsabilidades:     Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.    Pré-requisitos:     Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.    Diferencial:     Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.    Você terá:     Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.    Modo de contratação:     Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital    Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Remote litigation lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote litigation lawyer - brazil em mogi das cruzes. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M& A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration. Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses. Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief. Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions). Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up. Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Data specialist (with advanced english) em navegantes. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.          Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Empresa está contratando Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713 em cajamar. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O que buscamos:      Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.      Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios     Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:      Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.    Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.   #Vempra GFT   #Vamos Voar Juntos   #Proud To Be GFT

title: Ai tech lead
description:
Confira a vaga para Ai tech lead em mogi guaçu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Preferred Time Zone: CT      Must-Have Skills:    Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality AI agents, skills, assistants, workflows, or integrations. Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows; skills, tools, and function calling; Model Context Protocol; prompt and context design; retrieval-augmented generation; enterprise search and data connectors; grounding, citations, memory, and context management; model and agent evaluation; and AI safety and access controls. Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise Saa S, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms. Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, Chat GPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management. Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority.      Nice-to-Have Skills:    Experience with single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, service accounts, delegated authorization, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, Type Script, Java Script, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.      Notes: No direct reports. This role is more leading through influence by setting standards, mentoring other admins/engineers, etc.      Strong preference in AI technology depth, with lighter platform administration experience rather than the other way around.    Scope of Work: The AI Platform Technical Lead is the hands-on technical owner of the organization's general-purpose, AI-enabled collaboration ecosystem, spanning Slack, Google Workspace with Gemini, Glean, and general-purpose AI assistants such as Claude and Chat GPT. Working within the strategy and priorities established by the organization, this role translates platform direction into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The Technical Lead configures, maintains, and improves these platforms based on data and feedback; builds agents and reusable skills; implements integrations; establishes technical patterns; and guides other contributors through technical expertise and example.    Key Responsibilities:   · Design, build, test, and maintain AI agents, skills, prompts, tools, workflows, and automations.   · Build AI solutions using MCP, function calling, APIs, agents, and integration frameworks.   · Translate business needs into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready AI capabilities.   · Build secure integrations across Slack, Google Workspace/Gemini, Glean, AI assistants, and enterprise systems.   · Develop APIs, data connectors, webhooks, search integrations, and RAG/semantic-search solutions.   · Ensure AI systems preserve source-system permissions, access controls, data security, and governance requirements.   · Test and evaluate AI solutions for quality, reliability, safety, performance, and data grounding.   · Administer and optimize enterprise AI platforms, including access, configurations, integrations, monitoring, and lifecycle management.   · Troubleshoot complex AI platform, integration, connector, and data-retrieval issues.   · Establish standards for AI agents, integrations, configurations, testing, deployment, and security.   · Lead technical solution reviews, mentor contributors, and serve as the senior technical escalation point.   · Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide technical recommendations to platform leadership.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Remote real estate lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote real estate lawyer - brazil em limeira. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?      Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .      Necessário:     Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.    O diferencial?      Aqui você é mais que um professor.      Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.      Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.      Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.      Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.      Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!      O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?     Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.      Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

About i QIYI    i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.      Role purpose    Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.      Key responsibilities   1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.    Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes operacionais e lideranças. Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática e engajadora. title: Corporate travel agent
description:
Confira a vaga para Corporate travel agent em franco da rocha. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager      Company Overview:    b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models:  B2 C (exclusive membership services),  B2 B (corporate travel management), and  B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2 B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our  b Td Corp Tool .    This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.      CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)    We are looking for two (2)  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.      Main Responsibilities   • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.   • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email.   • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.   • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.   • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.      Requirements   • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.   • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level   (An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)   • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.   • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.   • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.   Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus      Why Join Us   • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.   • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.   • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.   • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements      b Td Travel Culture:    At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.    b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.      Terms of Employment: Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.    Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team.    Important Note Before Applying:    Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  Linked In profile or  updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a  self-starter ready to deliver results from  day one .    Forget gaming Linked In algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.    Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!      b Td Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em atibaia. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
